{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"call_MHxwUzJHTzdJZDhsRDBTRVFWWFg","type":"tool_result","content":"package memory // import \"github.com/giantswarm/mcp-oauth/storage/memory\"\n\nPackage memory provides an in-memory implementation of the OAuth storage\ninterfaces.\n\nThis package implements TokenStore, ClientStore, and FlowStore interfaces using\nGo's built-in maps with mutex protection for thread safety. It is suitable for\ndevelopment, testing, and single-instance deployments where persistence is not\nrequired.\n\nFeatures:\n  - Thread-safe operations using sync.RWMutex\n  - Automatic cleanup of expired tokens, codes, and flows\n  - Configurable cleanup intervals\n  - Token encryption support via Encryptor\n  - Audit logging support via Auditor\n\nFor production deployments requiring persistence or multi-instance deployments,\nuse the storage/valkey package instead.\n\nExample usage:\n\n    // Plain store (no encryption, default 1m cleanup interval):\n    store := memory.New()\n    defer store.Stop()\n\n    // With encryption at rest and a custom cleanup interval:\n    key, _ := security.GenerateKey()\n    enc, _ := security.NewEncryptor(key)\n    store := memory.New(memory.WithEncryptor(enc), memory.WithCleanupInterval(30*time.Second))\n    defer store.Stop()\n\n    // Use store for TokenStore, ClientStore, and FlowStore interfaces:\n    server, _ := oauth.NewServer(provider, store, store, store, config, logger)\n\nPackage memory provides an in-memory implementation of all storage interfaces.\nIt is suitable for development, testing, and single-instance deployments.\n\ntype Option func(*Store)\n    func WithCleanupInterval(d time.Duration) Option\n    func WithEncryptor(enc *security.Encryptor) Option\n    func WithInstrumentation(inst *instrumentation.Instrumentation) Option\n    func WithLogger(logger *slog.Logger) Option\n    func WithRevokedFamilyRetentionDays(days int64) Option\ntype RefreshTokenFamily struct{ ... }\ntype Store struct{ ... }\n    func New(opts ...Option) *Store\npackage valkey // import \"github.com/giantswarm/mcp-oauth/storage/valkey\"\n\nPackage valkey provides a Valkey storage backend for the mcp-oauth library.\n\nValkey is a high-performance key-value store that is wire-compatible with Redis.\nThis package implements all storage interfaces required by the mcp-oauth\nlibrary, making it suitable for production deployments that require:\n\n  - Distributed storage for horizontal scaling\n  - Persistence across server restarts\n  - Automatic TTL-based expiration\n  - High availability with clustering\n\n# Implemented Interfaces\n\nThe Store type implements all required storage interfaces:\n\n  - storage.TokenStore: Token management (save, get, delete tokens and user\n    info)\n  - storage.ClientStore: OAuth client management (save, get, validate clients)\n  - storage.FlowStore: Authorization flow management (states, codes)\n  - storage.RefreshTokenFamilyStore: OAuth 2.1 token family tracking for reuse\n    detection\n  - storage.TokenRevocationStore: Bulk token revocation for security scenarios\n\n# Key Schema\n\nAll keys use a configurable prefix (default \"mcp:\") to avoid conflicts with\nother applications sharing the same Valkey instance:\n\n    {prefix}:token:{userID}           -> JSON(oauth2.Token)\n    {prefix}:userinfo:{userID}        -> JSON(UserInfo)\n    {prefix}:refresh:{token}          -> userID (with TTL)\n    {prefix}:refresh:meta:{token}     -> JSON(familyMetadata)\n    {prefix}:client:{clientID}        -> JSON(Client)\n    {prefix}:client:ip:{ip}           -> count (with TTL)\n    {prefix}:state:{stateID}          -> JSON(AuthorizationState)\n    {prefix}:state:provider:{state}   -> stateID (for reverse lookup)\n    {prefix}:code:{code}              -> JSON(AuthorizationCode)\n    {prefix}:meta:{tokenID}           -> JSON(TokenMetadata)\n    {prefix}:userclient:{uid}:{cid}   -> SET of tokenIDs\n    {prefix}:family:{familyID}        -> SET of refresh tokens in family\n\n# Atomic Operations\n\nOAuth 2.1 requires certain operations to be atomic to prevent security issues:\n\n  - AtomicCheckAndMarkAuthCodeUsed: Prevents authorization code replay attacks\n  - AtomicGetAndDeleteRefreshToken: Prevents refresh token reuse attacks\n\nThese operations use Lua scripts to ensure atomicity in Valkey, providing the\nsame security guarantees as the in-memory implementation but with distributed\nstorage benefits.\n\n# Configuration\n\nBasic usage:\n\n    store, err := valkey.New(valkey.Config{\n        Address:   \"localhost:6379\",\n        KeyPrefix: \"mcp:\",\n    })\n\nWith TLS:\n\n    store, err := valkey.New(valkey.Config{\n        Address:   \"valkey.example.com:6379\",\n        Password:  os.Getenv(\"VALKEY_PASSWORD\"),\n        TLS:       &tls.Config{MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12},\n        KeyPrefix: \"mcp:\",\n    })\n\n# Security Considerations\n\n  - All tokens are stored with TTLs to prevent unbounded growth\n  - Lua scripts ensure atomic operations for security-critical flows\n  - Constant-time bcrypt comparison prevents timing attacks in client validation\n  - TLS support enables encrypted connections to Valkey servers\n  - Family metadata is retained for configurable period for security forensics\n  - Optional token encryption at rest via WithEncryptor() using AES-256-GCM\n  - Input size validation prevents DoS attacks via oversized payloads\n  - Generic error messages prevent information leakage\n\n# Token Encryption at Rest\n\nSensitive oauth2.Token fields (AccessToken, RefreshToken) can be encrypted\nbefore storing in Valkey:\n\n    key, _ := security.GenerateKey()\n    encryptor, _ := security.NewEncryptor(key)\n    store, err := valkey.New(cfg, valkey.WithEncryptor(encryptor))\n\nWhen enabled, tokens are encrypted with AES-256-GCM before storage and\nautomatically decrypted when retrieved.\n\n# Best Practices\n\n  - Monitor key count and memory usage for potential DoS attacks\n  - Configure appropriate TTLs based on your security requirements\n\nconst DefaultKeyPrefix = \"mcp:\" ...\nfunc NewDPoPReplayCache(client vk.Client, keyPrefix string) server.DPoPReplayCache\ntype Config struct{ ... }\ntype Option func(*Store)\n    func WithEncryptor(enc *security.Encryptor) Option\n    func WithInstrumentation(inst *instrumentation.Instrumentation) Option\ntype Store struct{ ... }\n    func New(cfg Config, opts ...Option) (*Store, error)","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"813ba12b-4ae3-4340-b83f-bfa52b4d8e15","uuid":"b07c1436-6b18-47e4-85cd-76d7c56e4f2e","timestamp":"2026-07-01T14:57:33.708Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"package memory // import \"github.com/giantswarm/mcp-oauth/storage/memory\"\n\nPackage memory provides an in-memory implementation of the OAuth storage\ninterfaces.\n\nThis package implements TokenStore, ClientStore, and FlowStore interfaces using\nGo's built-in maps with mutex protection for thread safety. Distributed storage for horizontal scaling\n  - Persistence across server restarts\n  - Automatic TTL-based expiration\n  - High availability with clustering\n\n# Implemented Interfaces\n\nThe Store type implements all required storage interfaces:\n\n  - AtomicCheckAndMarkAuthCodeUsed: Prevents authorization code replay attacks\n  - AtomicGetAndDeleteRefreshToken: Prevents refresh token reuse attacks\n\nThese operations use Lua scripts to ensure atomicity in Valkey, providing the\nsame security guarantees as the in-memory implementation but with distributed\nstorage benefits.\n\n# Configuration\n\nBasic usage:\n\n    store, err := valkey.New(valkey.Config{\n        Address:   \"localhost:6379\",\n        KeyPrefix: \"mcp:\",\n    })\n\nWith TLS:\n\n    store, err := valkey.New(valkey.Config{\n        Address:   \"valkey.example.com:6379\",\n        Password:  os.Getenv(\"VALKEY_PASSWORD\"),\n        TLS:       &tls.Config{MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12},\n        KeyPrefix: \"mcp:\",\n    })\n\n# Security Considerations\n\n  -
